<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Upload } from "minerva-design/vue";
import type { UploadItem } from "minerva-design/vue";
const files = ref<UploadItem[]>([]);
function selected(items: File[]) {
  files.value.push(
    ...items.map((file, index) => ({
      id: `${Date.now()}-${index}`,
      name: file.name,
      status: "done" as const,
    })),
  );
}
</script>
<template>
  <Upload
    v-model="files"
    label="Attachments"
    multiple
    @files-selected="selected"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Upload } from "minerva-design/vue";
import type { UploadItem } from "minerva-design/vue";
const files = ref<UploadItem[]>([
  {
    id: "failed",
    name: "report.pdf",
    status: "error",
    error: "Transfer interrupted",
  },
]);
async function retry(item: UploadItem) {
  item.status = "uploading";
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  item.status = "done";
  item.error = undefined;
}
function selected(items: File[]) {
  for (const file of items) {
    const item: UploadItem = {
      id: String(Date.now()),
      name: file.name,
      status: "uploading",
    };
    files.value.push(item);
    void retry(files.value[files.value.length - 1]!);
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <Upload
    v-model="files"
    label="Transfer queue"
    @retry="retry"
    @files-selected="selected"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Upload
translationResources.description: Selects files by button or drag and drop, validates them and lists them with their transfer state. The transfer itself stays in your code.

basic.title: Single file
basic.description: onFilesSelected receives files that pass accept and maxSize; reflect the transfer in value. replace lets a new file replace the current one.

multiple.title: Multiple files
multiple.description: multiple with maxCount; failed items show their error and a retry button when onRetry is set.

UploadProps.label: Visible label of the upload field (also names the file input)
UploadProps.value: Files to list, with their transfer state (controlled)
UploadProps.onFilesSelected: Called with the selected (or dropped) files once they pass accept, maxSize and maxCount. Transfer, cancellation and persisted URLs belong to the caller
UploadProps.onRemove: Called to remove a file; shows a remove button on every item
UploadProps.onRetry: Called to retry a failed file; shows a retry button on failed items
UploadProps.accept: Accepted file types, as for <input accept>
UploadProps.replace: Single-file mode: lets a new file replace the listed one (the existing file does not count toward maxCount)
UploadProps.maxCount: Maximum number of files, including the listed ones
UploadProps.maxSize: Maximum size of a file, in bytes
UploadProps.loading: Busy state: blocks new selections and retries (removal stays possible) and sets aria-busy
UploadProps.labels: Custom texts; each one overrides the localized default

UploadItem.name: File name shown in the list
UploadItem.error: Error message shown when status is "error"
UploadItem.previewUrl: Image preview URL (e.g. an object URL)

UploadLabels.uploading: Status text of an uploading file
UploadLabels.done: Status text of an uploaded file
UploadLabels.failed: Status text of a failed file without its own error message
UploadLabels.tooMany: Error shown when too many files are selected
UploadLabels.invalidType: Error shown when a file does not match accept
UploadLabels.tooLarge: Error shown when a file exceeds maxSize
UploadLabels.retry: Accessible label of the retry button of a file
UploadLabels.remove: Accessible label of the remove button of a file

cssVars.--upload-gap: Space between the label, the dropzone, the error and the file list
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-radius: Corner radius of the dropzone (defaults to --radius-md)
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-border-color: Dashed border color of the dropzone at rest
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-background: Background of the dropzone at rest
cssVars.--upload-preview-width: Width of an image preview in the file list
cssVars.--upload-preview-height: Height of an image preview in the file list
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-min-height: Minimum height of the dropzone (its content is centered)
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-active-color: Border and ring color of the dropzone while a file is dragged over it (defaults to --primary-color)
cssVars.--upload-item-background: Background of a file row (defaults to --surface-color)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Pick or drop files. accept and max-size reject invalid files with a message; replace swaps the single file, multiple + max-count allow several, and removable adds remove buttons.

transfer.title: Upload progress and retry
transfer.description: Canceling minerva-files-selected lets the page own items: files are listed as uploading, then done or failed (every second file fails once); retryable shows a retry button that fires minerva-retry.

form.title: In a form
form.description: Every listed file is submitted under name (multipart FormData); required blocks submission without files and reset empties the list.

props.removable: Shows a remove button on every item.
props.retryable: Shows a retry button on failed items.
props.required: An upload without files is invalid (valueMissing).
props.items: Listed files with their transfer state: an array of { id, name, status, error?, previewUrl?, file? } (property).
props.texts: Custom texts (the labels prop of the React library, renamed because labels is the form control's <label> list); each one overrides the localized default.
props.files: The files of the listed items, submitted with the form (read-only).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The listed files were changed by the user.
events.minerva-files-selected: Valid files were picked or dropped; detail: { files }. Cancelable: the files are then not listed.
events.minerva-change: The listed files were changed by the user; detail: { value } (the items).
events.minerva-remove: The remove button of an item was activated; detail: { item }. Cancelable: the item is then kept.
events.minerva-retry: The retry button of a failed item was activated; detail: { item }.

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the inner icon buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the inner icon buttons on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed inner icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed inner icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the inner icon buttons (defaults follow the density's control heights).
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the icons of the inner icon buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the inner icon buttons (defaults to --radius-lg).

methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: Interact with the native component in this phone preview.

native.limitations: The documentation supplies a browser file picker; the Expo example supplies the native system document picker. Selected files are local selections. Applications own transfer requests and upload progress.
